title: Collections & Objects — Where It Stands
thesis: One of the largest surfaces in the library: ~155 list operations in a 6,500-line Zig core behind a 1,600-method Haro face, a functional pipeline, deep-path search, Lodash-grade grouping, and a reflective object root that 449 classes inherit, tuned for millions of items with measured residency wins. Two honest limits keep it short of the very top: boxed value storage holds raw set-op throughput an order of magnitude below NumPy/native, and there are no persistent immutable structures.

lanes.note: Index, slice, section, insert, remove, reverse, swap, rotate, repeat; reads engine-backed (stz_list_get/slice/reverse/rotate); mutators hop through Haro
Engine-backed map_expr/filter_expr/reduce_expr with a string DSL (@item, @accumulator) plus W (engine) and WF (Haro function) predicate modes
Finder family engine-backed (find_cs, find_all_cs, find_nth_cs, contains_cs) plus a deep-path API (deep_find, item_at_path, paths_at_depth)
Union, intersection, difference, subset, unique engine-backed with a splitmix64 fast path; intersection_cs dedups, common_items_cs keeps dups; 1M union ~2-3s
classify_cs, partition, chunked, zip, interleave, sliding_window, frequencies_cs engine-backed; classify emits the nested shape engine-side (-51% at 1M)
sort, sort_cs, sort_descending, sort_by_expr, sort_on, sorted_insert plus is_sorted / is_strictly_increasing / is_monotonic, all engine-backed
sum, product, mean, median, variance, stddev, nth_largest, ranked engine-backed, also on stzListOfNumbers; deep statistics lives on the Statistics page
Haro assigns lists by value (safe by default, clean Copy()) but no persistent immutable structures with structural sharing; a modified copy is a full copy
Generation-keyed cache (FIFO at 8M items / 1024 entries): read-reuse 3.34s to 1.29s, Classify -51%, Union -34% at 1M; boxed *StzValue, Slices 4-5 open
One reflective root inherited by 449 classes: Attributes, Methods, Type, ObjectUID, cloning, Q-elevation, Verb/Verbed/VerbQ; #TODO notes incomplete abstraction
stzHashList, stzGrid, stzTree, stzSet, stzListOfLists, stzListOfPairs, stzListOfSections, stzYielder; mostly Haro-side; stzHashList folds keys to lowercase
stzListNamedParams, a 1,945-method grammar for natural-language named arguments with no direct peer; pure Haro and the least-verified under the fidelity grind

standouts: String-expression predicates run inside the engine, which the peers cannot do
A deep-path search API that Lodash get only approximates
A reflective object root 449 classes inherit, with Q-elevation and the Verb/Verbed/VerbQ grammar
Measured residency wins at 1M items: 2.6x read-reuse, Classify -51%, Union -34%
gaps: Finish the list narration / fidelity grind (312 of ~602 legacy blocks error)
Unboxed typed storage for native-speed set-ops
Complete the residency migration (Slices 4 and 5, ~32 marshal-in sites)
Persistent immutable collections with structural sharing
peers: Python list / set / collections / itertools / statistics
